foo4_cb.smtDecl: (declare-fun foo4_cb ((_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32)) (_ BitVec 32))
foo4_cb.desc: foo4_cb takes four 32-bit numbers, computes their sum modulo 8, but if the result is 1, it instead returns 2. Hence, the function can return any value in {0,2,3,4,5,6,7} but never 1.
